why: The quoted sentence exists verbatim at plugins/manifest-reference.md#environment-variables (was line 577 of the retired plugins-reference page) (whole line reads: 'Each value is available for substitution as ${user_config.KEY} in MCP and LSP server configs and hook commands. Non-sensitive values can also be substituted in skill and agent content. All values are exported to hook processes as CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_<KEY> environment variables, where <KEY> is the option key uppercased.' — note :579 then carves the shell back out: shell-form hook commands, monitor commands and MCP headersHelper REJECT ${user_config.*}). The claimed OUR STATE is stale and its consequence is false. Commit 2a1f6cb7 (2026-07-30, 'fix(plugins): a plugin's user config reaches its MCP, LSP and skill surfaces') added packages/shared/src/plugins/user-config-substitution.ts — a 355-line module that substitutes ${user_config.KEY} into MCP command/args/cwd/env/url/headers (substituteMcp, :251) and LSP command/args/env/workingDirectory/workspaceFolder (substituteLsp, :280), plus pluginUserConfigContentValues (:341) for the non-sensitive skill-content subset. It is WIRED, not dead: packages/shared/src/capabilities/resolver.ts:1837-1865 calls PluginUserConfigValues + substitutePluginCapabilityUserConfig on every mcp/lsp candidate and builds skillUserConfig for skill candidates; packages/shared/src/capabilities/runtime-skill-content.ts:685-687 performs the skill-body expansion. 23 tests pass across packages/shared/src/plugins/__tests__/user-config-substitution.test.ts and packages/shared/src/capabilities/__tests__/plugin-user-config-substitution.test.ts. The stated consequence — 'A plugin whose MCP server config references ${user_config.api_endpoint} therefore starts with the literal placeholder' — is wrong twice over: the value IS substituted, and when a referenced key is UNSET the capability is disabled with unavailableReason 'user-config-missing' plus a plugin.user_config.unset diagnostic (resolver.ts:1859-1879, asserted by the test 'refuses the MCP capability and names the field, never a value'), so it never starts with a literal placeholder either. This is the repo's documented recurring false positive in its exact shape: the cited identifier is real but the consequence was already handled a layer up. Not an inert-worklist §3 owner decision (no user_config row there) and not a deliberate product difference. What genuinely survives is smaller and differently shaped: (1) the deferral row at format-adapters/claude.ts:2263-2267 is STALE — 2a1f6cb7 never touched claude.ts, so the compatibility report still emits plugin.deferred.claude_user_config_substitution and format-adapters.test.ts:2718 still asserts it, over a comment claiming the substitution is unbuilt; (2) AGENT content is genuinely not substituted — resolver.ts:1863 gates skillUserConfig on candidate.kind === 'skill', and the separate 'agent' binding (resolver.ts:1237-1249) carries no pluginUserConfig, so :577's 'skill and agent content' is half-covered.
correctedState: ${user_config.KEY} substitution IS built and wired for MCP server configs, LSP server configs and skill content. packages/shared/src/plugins/user-config-substitution.ts (commit 2a1f6cb7, 2026-07-30) substitutes into MCP command/args/cwd/env/url/headers and LSP command/args/env/workingDirectory/workspaceFolder with sensitive values allowed, and exposes only the non-sensitive subset to skill bodies (a sensitive key referenced in a skill body stays a literal placeholder by construction). capabilities/resolver.ts:1837-1865 is the call site; runtime-skill-content.ts:685-687 expands the body. An unset referenced key does NOT start the server with a literal placeholder: the MCP/LSP capability is disabled with unavailableReason 'user-config-missing' and a plugin.user_config.unset diagnostic naming the keys; a sensitive value substituted into command/args/cwd/url (outside the pool's headers/env redaction set) raises plugin.user_config.unredacted_sink. Two real residual gaps: (a) format-adapters/claude.ts:2263-2267 still emits the now-false deferral row plugin.deferred.claude_user_config_substitution (asserted by format-adapters.test.ts:2718) — the commit that built the feature did not touch the adapter, so the compatibility report contradicts the runtime; (b) plugin AGENT content is not substituted, because resolver.ts:1863 gates the content-value map on kind === 'skill' and the agent binding carries no pluginUserConfig — so the second half of :577's 'skill and agent content' is unimplemented.
